serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: *Sigh*
Streets further away from the city center are much calmer at this hour. 
You can still hear faint noises, but that’s as much silence as you can get out in the open.
My room isn’t very soundproof. I guess Landlord is to blame for that.
Walking around like this is the best way to get some space and clear my mind…
Oh… Someone is walking straight towards me.
It isn’t that unusual in itself, but what is unusual is the sheer size of the man in question.
I know that giant lad.
